sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 2.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.110/2022 registered at Police Station Bamnora,
District Chhatarpur (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n)
and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is a consenting party.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is aged 14 years and 3 months.

She is minor and does not Arvind @ Rahul vs The State Of Mp on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105348373/
1 have sufficient maturity to under the consequences of the act.

sentences.text: In these circumstances he may not be released on bail.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5 . Prosecutrix is minor aged only about 14 years and 3 months.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
7. Trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as far as possible within period of six months.
